installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
cd /mnt/server
USER_AGENT="Panasaurus/0.1 (https://github.com/panasaurus/panel)"
API="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper"
fetch() {
    curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$1"
}
SHA256=""
if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL="$DL_PATH"
else
    PROJECT_DATA=$(fetch "$API")
    VERSIONS=$(printf '%s' "$PROJECT_DATA" | jq -er '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]')
    REQUESTED_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
    if [ "$REQUESTED_VERSION" != latest ] && ! printf '%s\n' "$VERSIONS" | grep -Fxq "$REQUESTED_VERSION"; then
        echo "Unknown Minecraft version: $REQUESTED_VERSION" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$REQUESTED_VERSION" != latest ]; then
        VERSIONS="$REQUESTED_VERSION"
    fi
    SELECTED="null"
    for VERSION in $VERSIONS; do
        BUILDS=$(fetch "$API/versions/$VERSION/builds")
        if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}" = latest ]; then
            SELECTED=$(printf '%s' "$BUILDS" | jq -c 'first(.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE")) // null')
        else
            SELECTED=$(printf '%s' "$BUILDS" | jq -c --arg build "$BUILD_NUMBER" 'first(.[] | select((.id | tostring) == $build and .channel == "STABLE")) // null')
        fi
        if [ "$SELECTED" != null ]; then
            break
        fi
    done
    if [ "$SELECTED" = null ]; then
        echo "No stable Paper build matches the requested version and build." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(printf '%s' "$SELECTED" | jq -er '.downloads."server:default".url')
    SHA256=$(printf '%s' "$SELECTED" | jq -er '.downloads."server:default".checksums.sha256')
    BUILD=$(printf '%s' "$SELECTED" | jq -er '.id')
    echo "Downloading Paper $VERSION build $BUILD"
fi
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
case "$JAR" in
    ""|*/*|*\\*|..|.*) echo "Invalid server jar filename." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
TEMP_JAR=$(mktemp ".paper-download.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$TEMP_JAR"' EXIT
fetch "$DOWNLOAD_URL" > "$TEMP_JAR"
if [ -n "$SHA256" ]; then
    printf '%s  %s\n' "$SHA256" "$TEMP_JAR" | sha256sum -c -
fi
if [ -f "$JAR" ]; then
    cp "$JAR" "$JAR.old"
fi
chmod 644 "$TEMP_JAR"
mv "$TEMP_JAR" "$JAR"
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    fetch "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties" > server.properties
fi
if [ -n "${SERVER_PORT:-}" ]; then
    sed -i '/^server-port=/d; /^query.port=/d; /^server-ip=/d' server.properties
    printf '\nserver-ip=0.0.0.0\nserver-port=%s\nquery.port=%s\n' "$SERVER_PORT" "$SERVER_PORT" >> server.properties
fi
echo "Paper installation complete."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version to download. Leave at latest for the newest version with a stable Paper build. Unavailable versions fail installation.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: A URL to use to download a server.jar rather than the ones in the install script. This is not user viewable.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Paper build number. Leave at latest for the newest stable build of the selected version. Unavailable builds fail installation.
